fato_historico: 1942: World War II: U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Wasp is sunk by Japanese torpedoes at Guadalcanal.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle shift in the winds of change. Just as a steady ship braves the turbulent tides of the deep, you are invited to navigate your emotions with grace. It is a good time to release what no longer serves your spirit, finding strength in your adaptability and letting your inner compass guide you forward.
frase_do_dia: Even through the deepest waters, your light remains a beacon for others.
significado_numero: Represents a harmonious alignment between your intuition and your daily creative expressions.
conselho: Consider pausing today to appreciate the quiet strength hidden within your own heart.
